source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever the bearer finishes a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, you may choose one enemy unit it passed over. Roll six D6 for that unit. It takes 1 **[mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** for every result of 3+.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

selection.subject: enemy unit the bearer passed over
